summary: All 12 prior findings from iteration 1 are resolved. 5 new findings identified. FIND-001 (major): buildCallbackRedirectUrl appends '/auth/complete' path contradicting REQ-AUTH-002 which forbids appending paths beyond FRONTEND_BASE_URL. FIND-002 (major): PROP-AUTH-031 through PROP-AUTH-036 referenced by contract but absent from verification-architecture.md, breaking traceability. FIND-003 (major): 7 Tier 2 integration tests call pure core functions directly, providing zero integration boundary coverage beyond what Tier 1 already covers. FIND-004 (minor): checkHealth error path untested. FIND-005 (minor): checkHealth has unreachable error code due to dynamic re-import of already-cached module. Overall verdict FAIL due to 3 major findings exceeding the contract's own threshold of 'at most 2 major findings total'.
